        const red = colors2.getX(i), green = colors2.getY(i), blue = colors2.getZ(i), gray = red * 0.2126 + green * 0.7152 + blue * 0.0722;
        colors2.setXYZ(i, gray + (red - gray) * 0.45, gray + (green - gray) * 0.45, gray + (blue - gray) * 0.45);
        if (flags?.itemSize >= 3 && flags.getZ(i) > 0) {
          colors2.setXYZ(i, gray * 0.12, gray * 0.12, gray * 0.12);
          flags.setZ(i, 0);
        }
      }
      if (!geometry.boundingSphere) geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
      let frozenMaterial = this.frozenMaterials.get(material);
      if (!frozenMaterial) {
        if (material instanceof PaletteMaterial) {
          let shared = sharedFrozenMaterials.get(material);
          if (!shared) {
            const copy = material.frozenCopy(true);
            copy.name = `corpse_${material.name}`;
            copy.positionNode = null;
            copy.normalNode = null;
            copy.maskNode = material.userData.frozenSurfaceMask ?? null;
            shared = { material: copy, users: 0 };
            sharedFrozenMaterials.set(material, shared);
          }
          shared.users++;
          frozenMaterial = shared.material;
        } else {
          frozenMaterial = new MeshLambertNodeMaterial2().copy(material);
          frozenMaterial.positionNode = null;
          frozenMaterial.normalNode = null;
          frozenMaterial.maskNode = material.userData.frozenSurfaceMask ?? null;
        }
        frozenMaterial.normalNode = skinnedWoundNormal(normalViewGeometry);
        corpseStencil(frozenMaterial);
        this.frozenMaterials.set(material, frozenMaterial);
      }
      frozen = { geometry, material: frozenMaterial };
      this.frozen.set(frozenKey, frozen);
    }
    return frozen;
  }
  createPage(key, source, material, clip, frame, hiddenParts, hidesHair = false) {
    let pages = this.chunks.get(key);
    if (!pages) {
      pages = [];
      this.chunks.set(key, pages);
    }
    const frozen = this.frozenPose(source, material, clip, frame, hiddenParts, hidesHair);
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry3();
    for (const name of ["position", "normal", "color", "_parts", ...frozen.geometry.hasAttribute("uv") ? ["uv"] : []]) geometry.setAttribute(name, frozen.geometry.getAttribute(name));
    geometry.setIndex(frozen.geometry.getIndex());
    geometry.boundingSphere = frozen.geometry.boundingSphere.clone();
    const shared = interleavedSurfaces.get(frozen.geometry);
    if (shared) for (const [name, attribute7] of Object.entries(shared)) geometry.setAttribute(name, attribute7);
    else {
      interleaveCrowdSurface(geometry);
      interleavedSurfaces.set(frozen.geometry, { ...geometry.attributes });
    }
    const state = new InstancedBufferAttribute3(new Float32Array(128 * 4), 4);
    const colors2 = new InstancedBufferAttribute3(new Float32Array(128 * 4), 4);
    const stains = new InstancedBufferAttribute3(new Float32Array(128 * 4), 4);
    geometry.setAttribute("_state", state);
    geometry.setAttribute("_variant", colors2);
    geometry.setAttribute("_overlay", stains);
    const mesh = new InstancedMesh2(geometry, frozen.material, 128);
    mesh.count = 0;
    mesh.visible = false;
    mesh.name = `corpses:${key}`;
    mesh.renderOrder = 2;
    if (frozen.material instanceof PaletteMaterial) {
      frozen.material.userData.batchFeatures = "corpses";
      mesh.instanceColor = new InstancedBufferAttribute3(new Float32Array(128 * 3).fill(1), 3);
      if (staticInstanceAttributes(mesh)) geometry.dispose();
    }
    mesh.matrixAutoUpdate = false;
    mesh.matrixWorldAutoUpdate = this.matrixWorldAutoUpdate;
    mesh.castShadow = false;
    mesh.receiveShadow = true;
    mesh.userData.preRenderSolo = true;
    const surface = crowdSurfaceBindings.get(source);
    if (surface) {
      crowdSurfaceBindings.set(mesh.geometry, surface);
      const before = mesh.onBeforeRender;
      mesh.onBeforeRender = function(...args) {
        before.apply(this, args);
        surface.bind();
      };
    }
    mesh.userData.preRenderTextures = surface?.textures ?? material.userData.preRenderTextures ?? [];
    const probe = new CrowdFigureProbe();
    probe.lod = source.userData.crowdLod ?? "lod2";
    if (true) mesh.onAfterRender = () => {
      for (let i = 0; i < mesh.count && i < probe.figures.length; i++) probe.figures[i].drawn = true;
    };
    const page = { mesh, tint: mesh.geometry.getAttribute("_variant"), overlay: mesh.geometry.getAttribute("_overlay"), probe, keys: [], spheres: [] };
    pages.push(page);
    this.add(mesh);
    return page;
  }
  snapshot() {
    return { instances: this.bodies.size, draws: [...this.chunks.values()].reduce((n, pages) => n + pages.filter((page) => page.mesh.count > 0).length, 0), figures: [...this.chunks.values()].flatMap((pages) => pages.flatMap((page) => page.probe.figures)) };
  }
  /** Checkpoint restore and gore changes replace body membership. Retain warmed
   * surfaces/pages so the next death cannot rebuild their shaders. */
  clearBodies() {
    this.revision++;
    for (const pages of this.chunks.values()) for (const page of pages) {
      page.mesh.count = 0;
      page.mesh.visible = false;
      page.keys.length = page.spheres.length = page.probe.figures.length = 0;
    }
    this.bodies.clear();
    this.slots.clear();
    this.detailBodies.clear();
    this.detailSpatial.reset();
    this.detailed.clear();
    this.detailDirty = false;
  }
  reset() {
    this.revision++;
    for (const pages of this.chunks.values()) for (const { mesh } of pages) {
      mesh.geometry.dispose();
      mesh.dispose();
    }
    for (const frozen of this.frozen.values()) frozen.geometry.dispose();
    for (const [source, material] of this.frozenMaterials) {
      if (!(source instanceof PaletteMaterial)) {
        material.dispose();
        continue;
      }
      const shared = sharedFrozenMaterials.get(source);
      if (--shared.users === 0) {
        material.dispose();
        sharedFrozenMaterials.delete(source);
      }
    }
    this.frozen.clear();
    this.frozenMaterials.clear();
    this.chunks.clear();
    this.bodies.clear();
    this.slots.clear();
    this.clear();
    this.detailBodies.clear();
    this.detailSpatial.reset();
    this.detailed.clear();
    this.detailDirty = false;
  }
  dispose() {
    this.reset();
  }
};

  StaticCorpses

## Method and limits

Apple M4 / Mac16,10 / 16 GiB / macOS 26.5.1 (25F80), Chromium 153.0.8010.12 / Playwright 1.63.0, headless native Metal WebGPU and ANGLE Metal WebGL2, 1280×720, DPR 1, seed 1.
